result.summary: The page displays a localized string key instead of a human-readable title in the 'popular' section.

issues.description: The section header 'home_feed.popular_title' is displaying a developer string key instead of the intended text (e.g., 'Popular in Tallinn').
issues.suggestion: Update the application's localization or content management system to correctly map the key 'home_feed.popular_title' to its intended translated string.
